meta.name: renobattery-bilingual
meta.plugin: Polylang (free) or Polylang Pro for ACF/Elementor
meta.rationale: Polylang keeps a row per language and uses URL prefix strategy — simpler than WPML, zero runtime overhead, plays well with Elementor templates.

notes: Polylang → Settings → URL modifications → 'The language is set from content' + 'Hide URL language information for default language' DISABLED (we want /en/ explicitness optional but SEO-clean).

acf_policy.rule: Use Polylang Pro or the 'ACF Polylang' bridge plugin to mark each field group as translatable/copyable at the field-group level.

elementor_templates.strategy: One saved template per language, linked via Polylang's built-in 'translation' relationship for posts. Theme-builder templates (header/footer/archive/single) must be duplicated per language with matching conditions.
elementor_templates.shortcut: For prototypes, enable Elementor's built-in string-translation compatibility: each template renders once; Polylang substitutes translated strings from the registered pot/po bundle. Full duplication only needed when the LAYOUT differs per language (rare).
recommended_workflow: 3. Polylang → Languages → Translate posts: duplicate to ZH.
4. Open ZH copy in Elementor, translate text-only widgets. Structure and settings remain identical.
5. Assign matching Theme Builder condition scoped to ZH language.

hreflang.output: Theme prints <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en"/ ...> and <link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" ...> tags in <head> for every page that has a translation.
hreflang.xml_sitemap: Polylang auto-appends <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang=".."> entries when used with Yoast/Rank Math XML sitemap.

string_translation.scope: All strings wrapped in __() / _e() / _n() in theme PHP + template JSONs' user-facing text.
tooling: Run WP-CLI i18n: `wp i18n make-pot wp-content/themes/renobattery wp-content/themes/renobattery/languages/renobattery.pot --domain=renobattery`
Translators edit zh_CN.po via Poedit or Polylang's in-admin String Translation UI.
Build .mo via `msgfmt languages/zh_CN.po -o languages/zh_CN.mo` or Polylang auto-compiles.
Theme's style.css declares Text Domain: renobattery.
ui_strings_registered_via_polylang_api: Nav labels (duplicated in Menus per language instead)
CTA button text, eyebrow labels, form placeholders — registered via pll_register_string() in inc/polylang.php

language_switcher_ui.contract: Navbar + mobile drawer + footer all render [polylang-switcher] shortcode with these attributes:

cpt_taxonomy_slugs.strategy: Polylang → Settings → Custom post types and Taxonomies → check all rb types; check 'Translate URL slugs' if using Polylang Pro.
cpt_taxonomy_slugs.note: If Polylang Free, leave slugs shared and only localize titles/content. That's fine for SEO as long as hreflang is correct.

font_stack_per_language.zh: PingFang SC → Noto Sans SC → Inter
font_stack_per_language.implementation: html[lang^='zh'] override in assets/css/tokens.css (already in place)

qa_parity: Every EN page has a ZH counterpart reachable by the language switcher.
Form labels, placeholders, error messages localized.
hreflang emitted on every canonical URL + x-default.
